source_title: People v. Enriquez (1996) 42 Cal.App.4th 661 — historical definition of under the influence
source_kind: California Court of Appeal primary opinion, hosted by Justia
retrieval_method: web-search-service open; primary opinion body inspected
locator: 42 Cal.App.4th 665–666; CALJIC 12.65 and 16.831 (1992 rev.), discussion of 12.60
authored_summary: 研究用摘要（非判决逐字全文）：Enriquez 要求在酒驾／药物影响驾驶案件中定义“受影响”，并讨论 CALJIC 12.60、12.65 与 16.831 的搭配。所需的是实际驾驶能力受损，无法保持相同情况下通常谨慎清醒者的驾驶标准；身体存在酒精或药物、或者药物一般可能影响驾驶，本身不能替代该要件。原案涉及药物，006的酒精情形另由 Ellis 的酒精指示支撑。
scope: Published opinion proposition only; no case facts are transferred into the synthetic trial.
